_comment: #1061 agreed per-source genlock_latency_ms_src pins baseline (issue 866 latency half). REPORT-ONLY source of truth: scripts/latency_pins_verify.py diffs live pins vs this at OBS start and reports drift LOUD (box+input+got+want) -- it NEVER overwrites, because per-source latency is the operator's A/V-align domain. When the operator/gate LEGITIMATELY re-tunes a pin, record the new agreement by updating this file in a PR. Seeded from the live 2026-08-15 read-only WS snapshot. issue 1168 (2026-09-15): strih is the FLOOR-3 live model -- every on-air strih camera (cam1..cam7, the current CAMERA_ACTIVE_SET) at the 3 ms floor; the per-run [4i/8align] aligner (scripts/qr_align_pins.py) OWNS any relative offset (re-derived live, NEVER committed here), so the REPORT-ONLY reference is the floor. NOTE: after a successful per-run align writes above-floor offsets they PERSIST in the scene collection, so a later OBS-start verify legitimately REPORTS drift on the offset cameras (report-only, never overwritten) -- that is an align offset, not a real drift.
_align_model: #1003 owner rework (2026-08-20): production camera alignment is a per-run AUTOMATIC process (scripts/qr_align_pins.py, wired as recording-e2e.sh's BLOCKING [4i/8align] step), NOT a hand-baked baseline. Model = FLOOR-3: the slowest (max-transport) on-air strih camera gets pin 3, every other gets 3 + its RELATIVE delivery delta measured from the exact painter-QR gen_ts_ns difference (a simultaneous barrier screenshot of every on-air strih input, medianed over rounds, underrun-excluded). NEVER absolute depth -- the rejected 90/160/184 promotion added ~180 ms of needless chain latency and was REVERTED (0aaa2fc93). ALL on-air cameras incl. cam4 are aligned (CAMERA_ALIGN_SET, a superset of CAMERA_ACTIVE_SET). The floor-3 numbers are re-derived LIVE each run and are NEVER committed here -- so the strih block below is only the reverted-shallow drift-guard REFERENCE (report-only, latency_pins_verify.py), not the authoritative per-run set. DOMAINS: the aligner writes strih pins ONLY; the stream NDI 2ME PGM hold (operator A/V-align domain) and imag's 3 ms floor are never touched.
_strih_comment: issue 1168 (2026-09-15): refreshed to the FLOOR-3 live model -- cam1..cam7 = 3 (the whole current on-air CAMERA_ACTIVE_SET at the floor). This retired the stale cam3=20 drift-guard reference and extended the old cam1..cam3 set to cam1..cam7 (the fleet is 7 on-air cameras). The per-run [4i/8align] aligner writes any RELATIVE offset live and it is NEVER committed here, so this reference is the floor for every camera. cam2 (the projection probe, EXCLUDED from CAMERA_ALIGN_SET, issue 1216) is not floored by the aligner but its report-only floor reference is still 3 (issue 1168 lever 1 recorded cam2 6 -> 3; re-verify cam2's A/V before applying live via `apply_latency_pins.py --box strih --host 10.77.9.202 --pins '{"NDI cam2":3}' --execute`).

stream._comment: NDI 2ME PGM is the A/V-align program hold that tracks the ~1s mastered-audio delay (~923ms design); the +/-60ms band absorbs ordinary re-tuning while still catching a gross revert (0/3/1000). Zaloha kamera (standby backup) is intentionally not pinned here.

imag._comment: imag is the low-latency IMAG projection: EVERY NDI input runs the 3ms floor, ALWAYS (imag-min-latency-3ms-always). A floor sentinel (not a per-name list) because imag's input set is dynamic/16-wide; latency_pins_verify enumerates live NDI inputs and every one must equal the floor.

resolume._comment: #1295 RESOLUME-SNV cg OBS: the SongPlayer `sp-*_video` inputs ride the genlock FIFO at the 3ms floor. REPORT-ONLY drift reference (latency_pins_verify.py --box resolume), same as every box here. NOTE the genlock build DEFAULTS every ndi_source to genlock_fifo=true + genlock_latency_ms_src=3 (vendor/distroav/src/ndi-source.cpp) + auto-forces the certified coercion (ndi_sync=2 timecode / ndi_bw_mode=0 highest), so this pin is CONFIRMED by the build, not written by a tool; a hand re-pin uses `apply_latency_pins.py --box resolume --host <ip> --pins '{...}' --execute` with the live sp-* names. A PREFIX-MATCH sentinel (not a fixed name list and not the all-inputs floor): only the sp-*_video inputs are in scope; the box's NDIAr/VBAN overlays may legitimately differ and must NOT be drift-reported. The regex mirrors scripts/lib/cg-chain-verify.sh's operator-overridable `sp-.*_video` (CASE-INSENSITIVE) -- the sp-* name set is a pattern, never a hardcoded list.

strih-lx._comment: issue 1317: the Linux strih notebook running IN PARALLEL with the Windows STRIH-SNV cutter. Its camera NDI inputs (CAM1..CAM7 (usb)) ride the genlock FIFO at the same FLOOR-3 model as strih above (the per-run [4i/8align] aligner writes any RELATIVE offset live and it is NEVER committed here, so this reference is the floor). REPORT-ONLY drift reference (verify-strih.sh reads _all_camera_ndi_inputs_ms; per-source latency is the operator's A/V-align domain -- never overwritten). The self-feedback 2ME + RESOLUME-SNV (cg-obs) inputs are not floored here (see .claude/rules/strih-linux-provisioning.md).
